fixes.explanation: That's what verse 7 says. The anger of the LORD burned against Uzzah, and God struck him down on the spot. He died there beside the ark of God. Uzzah was one of the sons of Abinadab who were guiding the new cart (verse 3).

That isn't what happens here. Verse 7 says God struck Uzzah down on the spot, and he died there beside the ark of God. The text doesn't mention his hand. Uzzah had reached out and taken hold of the ark because the oxen had stumbled (verse 6).
Uzzah isn't sent anywhere. Verse 7 says God struck him down on the spot, and he died there beside the ark of God. He had reached out and taken hold of the ark because the oxen had stumbled (verse 6).

That's it, friend! Verse 12 says David went and had the ark of God brought up from the house of Obed-edom into the City of David with rejoicing. The report comes in and David is OUT THE DOOR. I'd have beaten him there if my base had wheels! And look at that last word: rejoicing. This trip is a whole lot happier than the first one.
